newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco sees 77 cents aluminium price.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco sees 77 cents aluminium price.

text.p: Aluminium producer Comalco Ltd said on Monday it saw aluminium prices averaging 77 US cent per pound in calendar 1997.
"I'm looking for about a 77 cent average over the year," Chief Executive Terry Palmer told reporters.
"That's actually my expectation, but my crystal ball is no better than anyone else's," he added.
The aluminium price, which averaged 70 US cent per pound over 1996, has recovered to 73 cents in early 1997, Palmer said.
"I would like to see an average somewhat higher than we have got at the moment. Since we are at the end of February already, I am looking for another four cents average for the year," Palmer said.
